topic: Analytics deployment status and next steps
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on the deployment of analytics features. One participant confirmed they would start working on the necessary tasks today. Two specific tasks were identified: a sandbox setup and Kubernetes integration, with one participant suggesting the sandbox might be simpler to implement first. The immediate goal was to push the latest analytics data from `mall-frequency` to staging, which is currently being built. A follow-up check was scheduled for approximately seven minutes after the build completes.
decisions: The latest analytics data from mall-frequency will be pushed to staging.
